questions.question_text: Which is the standard place-value partition of $7.305$?

options.why: Dropped the zero placeholder in the hundredths column, reading the number as $7.35$ so the $5$ became five hundredths.
Named the first decimal place hundredths, so the $3$ was written as three hundredths instead of three tenths.
Made both slips at once: named the first decimal place hundredths for the $3$ and dropped the zero placeholder, so the $5$ was also read as hundredths, giving $7.08$.
Placed eight hundredths in the tenths column, making the decimal ten times too large.
Placed both decimal parts one column too far left before combining them.
Added the digits $8$ and $6$ as $14$ thousandths instead of aligning place values.

questions.question_text: What part does the digit $6$ contribute to $9.261$?

options.why: Read the hundredths digit as tenths, making its contribution ten times too large.
Read the hundredths digit as thousandths, making its contribution ten times too small.
Used the digit itself without multiplying it by its decimal place value.

questions.solution_text: The $6$ is in the hundredths place, so its part is $0.06$.

questions.question_text: Which non-standard partition of $0.739$ begins with $0.6$?

options.why: Removed two tenths instead of one tenth when regrouping $0.739$.
Dropped the nine thousandths from the remainder after regrouping.
Added the new first part without subtracting it from the original decimal.
Ignored the $0.7$ part that must also be removed from the decimal.
Removed eight tenths rather than the given seven tenths from the decimal part.
Removed six tenths rather than the given seven tenths from the decimal part.

questions.question_text: Which partition of $2.654$ has three non-zero parts and uses none of the standard parts $2$, $0.6$, $0.05$ or $0.004$?

options.why: Took the second part straight from the tenths digit of $2.654$ as $1.6$ but kept the remainder $0.154$, so the parts total $2.754$.
Mis-subtracted $2.654 - 2.5$ as $0.104$, losing five hundredths, so the parts total $2.604$.
Made both slips at once: used $1.6$ for the second part and mis-subtracted the remainder as $0.104$, so the parts total $2.704$.
